# Relata counted through relations

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> The number of relata each list of each world holds, read up to indiscernibility, is fixed exactly under excluded middle; counting by name gives one decided identity more; read by occurrence, every flow lists what takes part once with its amounts unchanged.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Every list over a type can be listed once exactly where identity on the type is decided (listsOnce_all_iff). Two relata of a world are indiscernible (World.Indiscernible) where at every step they are alike in activity, level and taking part, and alike in every relation to every relatum, either way round; this is a likeness (World.indiscernible_equivalence). Up to a likeness the number of relata a list holds (NumbersBy) is one number (NumbersBy.unique) and exists exactly where likeness among its members is decided (numbersBy_iff_decided); counting by name is counting up to identity of names (numbers_iff_numbersBy_eq). Asked of every world, whether two relata are indiscernible is decided, and the number of relata each list holds is fixed, exactly under excluded middle (World.indiscernible_decided_iff_em, World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em; in the probe world World.probe two relata are indiscernible exactly where Q holds, World.probe_indiscernible). Names count what relations do not tell apart: where Q holds, the list of both has two members by name and holds one relatum through relations (World.probe_named_apart). Read by occurrence (Flow.byOccurrence, Web.byOccurrence), each place in a step's list is taken as a relatum of its own, alike in every relation to the relatum there (Flow.byOccurrence_alike); every flow so read lists what takes part once with no decided identity (Flow.byOccurrence_once) and keeps its amounts, takers, closure, dissipation, balance and activity premises (Flow.byOccurrence_dissipative, Flow.byOccurrence_balances and others), so balance composes across a coarse step for every flow read by occurrence (Flow.BalancesOn.sample_byOccurrence). Occurrences are not followed across steps: wherever a relatum is active, no list holds all its active occurrences (Flow.byOccurrence_uncounted). No premise.

Canonical source: [Listing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Listing.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The boundary theorems are two-way: the left side is stated of every world or every type, the right side is excluded middle or decided identity.
- Read by occurrence, an occurrence is a pair (place number, relatum); activity is read through the relatum, so each active relatum has infinitely many active occurrences, a choice of this reading and not a finding about worlds.

P77 (work board), as above. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): identity itself is read off the relations only up to indiscernibility, and the core's names give one decided identity more than the relations do: asked of every world, the count through relations is fixed only under excluded middle, as in P58's law_iff_em. Read by occurrence, listing once fixes what one taking part is and restricts nothing for the amounts. The connection to P69's Alike (likeness of configurations across frames) is left to integration. See the integration document §101.

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 85 theorems of Becoming.Listing all have empty axiom reports, among them listsOnce_all_iff, World.Indiscernible, NumbersBy, numbersBy_iff_decided, World.indiscernible_decided_iff_em, World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em, World.probe, World.probe_named_apart, Flow.byOccurrence, Flow.byOccurrence_once and Flow.byOccurrence_uncounted. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §101 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Occurrences are not followed across steps, so the laws counting relata keep their census; identity of names (Lean's =) admits no excluded-middle boundary, since the pure core uses no propext, funext or quotient; the connection to P69's Alike is not made; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.

- The probe world: two by name, one through relations (World.probe_named_apart). [Listing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Listing.lean)
